definition.title: Retry queue backoff
definition.scenario: A delivery queue retries failed requests. During an incident, large retry delays kept recovery jobs waiting long after the service became available.
definition.aiClaim: The delivery handover claims that exponential delay is capped and invalid attempt counts are rejected.

requirements.text: Use 100 ms times two to the power of the attempt count, capped at 1,000 ms.
Reject negative and fractional attempt counts. The first retry is attempt zero.

publicIssues.title: Cap the retry delay
publicIssues.observed: The fifth retry is scheduled long beyond the maximum delay.
publicIssues.suggestedChange: Keep the growth below the cap and use the cap above it.

publicTests.action: Calculate the first retry and the third retry.
publicTests.expected: The delays are 100 ms and 400 ms.

publicTests.action: Calculate delay well above the cap.

targets.explanation: Below the maximum, the delay doubles on each retry. Once the raw delay exceeds 1,000 ms, the scheduled delay stays at 1,000 ms. Test ordinary growth separately from the cap.
